kultivator.naga.liar.source: Source: Journey to the West ch. 15: the white dragon, son of the Dragon King of the Western Sea, swallows Tang Sanzang's horse at Eagle Grief Gorge and is subdued by Guanyin into the White Dragon Horse; Investiture of the Gods ch. 12: Nezha churns the Eastern Sea with the Red Armillary Sash and the Universe Ring and defeats Ao Bing; Zuo Zhuan, Duke Zhao year 29: Dong Fu reared dragons for Emperor Shun and was given the surname Dong and the clan name Huanlong, "Dragon Rearer". Wild Jiao, the contest of wills and the numbers are game design.
kultivator.naga.evolusi.source: Source: Classic of Mountains and Seas part 1 (Southern Mountains): on Mount Qingqiu lives a beast like a fox with nine tails; part 2 (Western Mountains): the Tiangou of Mount Yin, like a wildcat with a white head; Guo Pu's Xuanzhong Ji: a fox of a thousand years communes with Heaven and becomes a Heavenly Fox; part 14 (Great Wilds East): Yinglong slays Chiyou and Kuafu (Guangya: a winged dragon is called Yinglong). Inspired by the tribulations of demon beasts in xianxia and by Bebe, who keeps evolving, in Coiling Dragon. Tiers, requirements and numbers are game design.
A spirit-silk sash woven with spirit tail feathers and an ice pearl.
Right-click a weakened (Lemah) Jiao to start the Contest of Wills: hold right-click and turn your view to keep your arc on the dragon's will.
Needs Deity Transformation (Thunder Jiao: Dao Union). Spent on every attempt.

kultivator.screen.help.naga_liar.title: Wild Dragons
kultivator.screen.help.naga_liar: From Nascent Soul on, Jiao sometimes fly in the Overworld sky: Water Jiao over rivers and seas, Cloud Jiao over mountains and dense Qi mist, Thunder Jiao only in a thunderstorm (more often during a spirit meteor shower or twin moons). It is neutral until attacked or until you fly too close at its height. In a fight it breathes its element, sweeps with its tail, roars (Weakness 4 s) and coils. At 25%% health it is exhausted and hovers low for 30 s: use the Dragon-Binding Sash (3 Spirit Tail Feathers, 2 High Spirit Stones, 1 Cold Ice Pearl) for an 8 s Contest of Wills; hold right-click and turn your view to keep your gold arc on the dragon's will (60%% wins). A subdued Jiao lives in the Bonded Dragon Pearl: summon it, ride it (Dragon Breath runs out in the air and refills on the ground) and it breathes at your foes. A slain Jiao leaves Jiao Scales and sometimes a Jiao Pearl. Below half health it enters Dragon Fury (faster arts, +20%% damage, red burning eyes) and uses its element art more often: Ocean Whirl (Water Jiao: a ring of water drags you round and in), Cloud Veil (Cloud Jiao: blinding mist, then a bite from behind) and Heavenly Thunder Rain (Thunder Jiao: rings of light, then strikes). A ring on the ground is the warning: step out. Under the blood eclipse Jiao are born in Blood Frenzy (provoked sooner, +15%% damage); under twin moons they are calm. Cultivators of Immortal Ascension and above do not provoke it. Half of all slain Jiao leave Jiao Blood: drink it for +3 Dao comprehension (+5 when its element matches).
kultivator.screen.help.evolusi_binatang: After tier 3 a spirit beast only climbs through the Spirit Beast Tribulation: tier 4 (4,000 XP, you at Deity Transformation), 5 (12,000 XP, Immortal Ascension), 6 (40,000 XP, True Immortal). Sneak + right-click your beast under the open sky holding the offering; sneak + right-click with an empty hand shows what is missing. Offerings: tier 4 a King Beast Core + 3 Spirit Meteor Stones (or 3 High Spirit Stones); tier 5 an Ancient Demon Core (wolf), 3 Spirit Tail Feathers (fox) or a Dragon Pearl (Jiao), or 1 Supreme Spirit Stone; tier 6 an Immortal Peach (or 2 Supreme Spirit Stones) + 3 Tomb Essence. After a 10 s omen come 3 / 5 / 7 strikes; stand within 6 blocks as its Hu Fa to bear 30%% of each strike (never lethal). A strike that would kill fails the tribulation: your beast survives at 1 health with a one-day Tribulation Wound and half the offering comes back. Tier 4 wakes the Moon Howl (wolf), Heavenly Foxfire (fox) or the Dragon Breath; tier 6 blesses you. A tamed Jiao rests coiled around you when you stand still and speaks through divine sense from tier 5 (True Dragon); from tier 5 it also uses its element art on your foes every 30 s. While your soul walks the Underworld, your spirit beasts within 64 blocks and your summoned Jiao guard your body from monsters (Body Guardians).

kultivator.naga.say.greet_day.beast.0: bursts from the pearl, shakes its mane in the sunlight and nudges your shoulder.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_day.beast.1: circles you once and purrs low, like distant thunder.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_day.sage.0: The sun is high and the wind is clean. Where do we fly today?
kultivator.naga.say.greet_day.sage.1: You call, I come. Such is our bond.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_night.beast.0: slips from the pearl without a sound; its eyes glow like two small moons.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_night.beast.1: looks up at the night sky, then coils close above you, watchful.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_night.sage.0: Night is when demons roam. I keep watch.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_night.sage.1: The stars remember my ancestors. Let us fly beneath them.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_rain.beast.0: opens its jaws to the rain and drinks the drops with delight.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_rain.beast.1: its scales gleam wet; it hisses happily like surf on a reef.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_rain.sage.0: Rain is a dragon's breath. Today I am strong.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_rain.sage.1: These clouds belong to my kin. They welcome us.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_storm.beast.0: roars at the lightning and violet light crawls along its scales.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_storm.beast.1: whirls wildly in the storm, then returns to your side with blazing eyes.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_storm.sage.0: A storm! Heaven is singing for us.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_storm.sage.1: The lightning will not touch you while I am here.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_hurt.beast.0: smells your blood and coils around you at once, growling at anything that comes near.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_hurt.beast.1: presses its brow to you, anxious; its breath is warm.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_hurt.sage.0: You are wounded. Who dared? Show me.
kultivator.naga.say.greet_hurt.sage.1: Breathe slowly. I shield you until your Qi returns.
kultivator.naga.say.rest.beast.0: coils lazily around you, closes its eyes, and its breath mists softly.
kultivator.naga.say.rest.beast.1: rests its chin near your feet and purrs like a river under ice.
kultivator.naga.say.rest.beast.2: scratches its scales on a stone, content, then dozes lightly.
kultivator.naga.say.rest.sage.0: Stillness, too, is part of the Dao. I listen to the earth breathe.
kultivator.naga.say.rest.sage.1: Meditate. I will wake you if the sky changes.
kultivator.naga.say.rest.sage.2: Once I slept a hundred years at the bottom of a lake. A moment with you feels longer.
kultivator.naga.say.ride_storm.beast.0: tears through the storm clouds with a joyful roar; lightning dances along its body.
kultivator.naga.say.ride_storm.beast.1: lowers its head into the wind to keep you safe on its back.
kultivator.naga.say.ride_storm.sage.0: Hold my mane! We fly in the heart of the storm!
kultivator.naga.say.ride_storm.sage.1: Feel that? The lightning knows us as kin.
kultivator.naga.say.ride_high.beast.0: rises above the sea of clouds and glides slowly, basking in the light.
kultivator.naga.say.ride_high.beast.1: snorts in contentment; up here the air is cold and clean.
kultivator.naga.say.ride_high.sage.0: Look: the mortal world is as small as a grain of dust from here.
kultivator.naga.say.ride_high.sage.1: Above the clouds there are no roads. Only your will and my wings.
kultivator.naga.say.protect.beast.0: roars in fury and dives at your foe, breath already gathering in its jaws.
kultivator.naga.say.protect.beast.1: shields you with its body and glares at the enemy with burning eyes.
kultivator.naga.say.protect.sage.0: Fall back! Let me face it.
kultivator.naga.say.protect.sage.1: No one touches my master and lives.
kultivator.naga.say.victory.beast.0: lifts its head and roars long at the sky, proud.
kultivator.naga.say.victory.beast.1: returns to you and waits for praise, its tail swaying.
kultivator.naga.say.victory.sage.0: A weak foe. Next time, find me a stronger one.
kultivator.naga.say.victory.sage.1: Together we are unstoppable. Remember this day.
kultivator.naga.warn.air.0: %s hisses like breaking surf: “Down, land-crawler. The sky above these waters is mine.”
kultivator.naga.warn.air.1: %s lashes its tail and the sea heaves: “One more beat of your wings and you drown.”
kultivator.naga.warn.awan.0: %s rolls inside the mist: “Who dares enter my clouds unbidden?”
kultivator.naga.warn.awan.1: %s vanishes into the cloud, then its voice comes from everywhere: “Leave while you can still see.”
kultivator.naga.warn.petir.0: %s growls and lightning crawls over its scales: “You fly in my storm. That is a mistake.”
kultivator.naga.warn.petir.1: %s stares at you with burning violet eyes: “Heaven punishes the insolent. I am Heaven's hand.”
kultivator.naga.lemah.air.0: %s pants, its waters ebbing: “You... run deeper than I thought.”
kultivator.naga.lemah.air.1: %s hangs low over the water, eyes dimming: “If you want me, prove your will.”
kultivator.naga.lemah.awan.0: %s loses its mist, scales pale: “My clouds cannot hide me from you.”
kultivator.naga.lemah.awan.1: %s sinks with white breath: “The wind stops for you. Just this once.”
kultivator.naga.lemah.petir.0: %s crackles as its lightning dies spark by spark: “The storm... bows to you?”
kultivator.naga.lemah.petir.1: %s growls weakly: “Defeat my will, not only my body.”

kultivator.naga.say.sky_meteor.beast.0: looks up at the falling stars and its eyes catch every streak of light.
kultivator.naga.say.sky_meteor.beast.1: circles restlessly, scenting the burning sky-stone.
kultivator.naga.say.sky_meteor.sage.0: Sky-stones are falling. There is treasure among them; I can smell it.
kultivator.naga.say.sky_meteor.sage.1: A star-rain like this wakes my kin across the whole sky.
kultivator.naga.say.sky_eclipse.beast.0: hisses at the red moon, the scales on its neck standing up.
kultivator.naga.say.sky_eclipse.beast.1: coils tight beside you and will not look at the sky.
kultivator.naga.say.sky_eclipse.sage.0: Blood in the sky. Wild Jiao will go mad tonight; do not fly close to them.
kultivator.naga.say.sky_eclipse.sage.1: This eclipse stirs an old rage in my blood. Hold me back if I forget myself.
kultivator.naga.say.sky_moons.beast.0: purrs softly beneath the two moons, its movements calm and slow.
kultivator.naga.say.sky_moons.beast.1: stretches its neck toward the silver light as if basking.
kultivator.naga.say.sky_moons.sage.0: Two moons... the Qi is clear tonight. Meditate; I keep watch.
kultivator.naga.say.sky_moons.sage.1: Under twin moons even wild dragons grow calm.
kultivator.naga.sky.wolf.eclipse: %s howls long at the red moon; its silver fur bristles.
kultivator.naga.sky.wolf.eclipse_tiangou: %s howls at the reddening moon: like the Tiangou of legend, it longs to swallow the moon.
kultivator.naga.sky.wolf.moons: %s howls at the two moons, its voice ringing clear through the night air.
kultivator.naga.sky.fox.moons: %s's tails glow silver beneath the twin moons.
kultivator.naga.sky.fox.meteor: %s watches the star-rain, and foxfire dances at the tips of its tails.
kultivator.naga.cmd.sky: Your Jiao and spirit beasts react to the sky (the sky itself does not change).
kultivator.naga.say.realm_up.beast.0: roars at the sky to celebrate your breakthrough, then touches its brow to yours.
kultivator.naga.say.realm_up.beast.1: whirls around you; its scales shiver as it feels your new Qi.
kultivator.naga.say.realm_up.sage.0: Your realm has risen. I felt it from my pearl, like a new dawn.
kultivator.naga.say.realm_up.sage.1: Good. A stronger master makes a stronger dragon.
